sentences: Kronecker coefficients describe multiplicities in representations associated with tensor spaces.
Normalizing the triples of partitions with positive coefficients and taking their closure produces a convex Kronecker polytope.
The question asks for the complexity of testing whether a given normalized triple belongs to this polytope, with the number of parts included in the input.
The partitions are encoded in binary, making dependence on their numerical size part of the computational issue.
An efficient membership method would strengthen the algorithmic tools available for representation-theoretic approaches to tensor complexity and algebraic lower bounds.
